tools.name: emetals_search_steel_specs
tools.description: Look up a steel grade: standard, description, typical uses, chemical composition limits (%) and mechanical properties by thickness (yield and tensile strength in MPa, elongation %). Data comes from published catalogues of Taiwanese mills (China Steel, Tung Ho Steel, Tang Eng, Yieh United and others)

tools.name: emetals_search_inventory
tools.description: Search steel products listed for sale on eMetals AI™ (plates, sections, bars, coils, pipes, offcuts and more): name, grade, size, quantity, price, city, and whether the item is EPD-certified green steel with its carbon intensity. Keyword and city accept English or Chinese (e.g. "angle" or 角鋼, "SUS30

tools.name: emetals_search_suppliers
tools.description: Search a directory of Taiwanese metal material and processing suppliers; companies registered on eMetals AI™ are listed first. Filter by company name, material or city; material and city accept English or Chinese (e.g. "stainless" or 不鏽鋼, "Changhua" or 彰化縣). Returns company name, district, material

tools.name: emetals_estimate_cbam
tools.description: Estimate embedded emissions (tCO2e) and EU CBAM certificate cost for steel exported to the EU. Input a production route (industry-average intensity, worldsteel 2023) or a carbon intensity such as an EPD A1–A3 value. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: emetals_search_inventory, emetals_search_suppliers · Private data: emetals_search_suppliers · Public sink: emetals_search_suppliers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: emetals_search_inventory, emetals_search_suppliers · Private data: emetals_search_suppliers · Public sink: emetals_search_suppliers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
